```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ", ")
```

```{r}
movies |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, boundary = 0,
                 fill = "firebrick", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "How critics score films on Rotten Tomatoes",
    subtitle = paste(format(nrow(movies), big.mark = ","), "films"),
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count",
    caption = "Source: Rotten Tomatoes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies_clean |>
  filter(tomatoMeter != 0, audienceScore != 0) |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_summary <- movies_gap |>
  summarize(mean_gap = mean(gap), n = n(), .by = genre) |>
  filter(n >= 100) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

movies_summary
```

```{r}
movies_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_gap,
             y = fct_reorder(genre, mean_gap, .desc = TRUE),
             fill = mean_gap > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "firebrick", "FALSE" = "steelblue"),
                    labels = c("TRUE" = "Critics rate higher",
                               "FALSE" = "Audiences rate higher")) +
  labs(
    title = "Critics and audiences disagree most about documentaries and horror",
    subtitle = "Average Tomatometer minus audience score by genre (genres with 100+ rows, zero scores removed)",
    x = "Average gap (critic score minus audience score)",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Rotten Tomatoes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
spiderman_titles <- c(
  "Spider-Man", "Spider-Man 2", "Spider-Man 3",
  "The Amazing Spider-Man", "The Amazing Spider-Man 2",
  "Spider-Man: Homecoming", "Spider-Man: Far From Home",
  "Spider-Man: No Way Home"
)

spiderman <- movies |>
  filter(title %in% spiderman_titles) |>
  mutate(actor = case_when(
    str_detect(title, "Amazing") ~ "Andrew Garfield",
    str_detect(title, ":") ~ "Tom Holland",
    .default = "Tobey Maguire"
  )) |>
  arrange(releaseDateTheaters)

spiderman |>
  pivot_longer(c(tomatoMeter, audienceScore), names_to = "source", values_to = "score") |>
  mutate(source = if_else(source == "tomatoMeter", "Critics (Tomatometer)", "Audiences")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_inorder(title), y = score, color = source, group = source)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) str_wrap(x, 12)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Critics (Tomatometer)" = "firebrick", "Audiences" = "steelblue")) +
  labs(
    title = "Critics liked early Spider-Man more than fans did, but they agree on Tom Holland's",
    subtitle = "Rotten Tomatoes scores for the eight live-action Spider-Man films, in release order",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Score (out of 100)",
    color = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Rotten Tomatoes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

```
